verses.text: Give the glory to your name, LORD. It belongs to you alone, because of your faithful love and truth.
Why should the nations get to say, “So where’s their God now?”
Our God is in heaven. He does whatever he chooses.
Their idols are silver and gold, made by human hands.
They have mouths that can’t speak and eyes that can’t see.
They have ears that can’t hear and noses that can’t smell.
They have hands that can’t feel and feet that can’t walk. Their throats can’t make a sound.
The people who make them will end up like them, and so will everyone who trusts them.
Israel, trust the LORD! He’s your help and your shield.
Family of Aaron, trust the LORD! He’s your help and your shield.
All you who fear the LORD, trust him! He’s your help and your shield.
The LORD remembers us and will bless us. He’ll bless the family of Israel and the family of Aaron.
He’ll bless everyone who fears him, from the least to the greatest.
May the LORD give you and your children more and more.
May the LORD who made heaven and earth bless you.
The heavens belong to the LORD, and he’s given the earth to humanity.
The dead don’t praise the LORD. Neither do those who go down into silence.
But we’ll bless the LORD from now on and forever. Praise the LORD!
